items.title: Relative class-number growth against ramification products for CM fields with solvable normal closures
items.author: Amir Akbary; Abbas Maarefparvar
items.difficulty_reason: The counted theorem combines effective and ineffective relative class-number estimates with ramification-product growth, controls unbounded solvable CM degrees through growing degree constants and separately handles quadratic/quartic exceptional degrees and bounded nonabelian degrees. Both original ramification-product assertions and their distinct hypotheses are retained as one theorem. Old183304 only concerns the regulator of real quadratic extended R-D fields1426–1506, a different family/object. Fixed Pólya-index consequences, field classifications, tables and all GRH/Artin-conditional or possibly-one-exception statements are original uncounted context, not upgraded to unconditional classifications.

primary.label: Complete original solvable-normal-closure CM growth theorem, both ramification products and effectivity scope

proof_spans.label: Complete cited lower-bound setup, author relative class-number bounds and all degree/discriminant branches of the main growth proof

contexts.label: Original class/genus/Pólya groups, relative class-number setup and earlier abelian results
